name: S3 object action on a bucket-only ARN: action/resource-type mismatch (test 50 in the resource context)
note: IAM-1204 / acceptance-suite-2 test 50 applied to a resource policy. An S3 bucket policy grants s3:GetObject (an OBJECT-level action) scoped to the BUCKET-only ARN arn:aws:s3:::documents (no '/*' and no key). A bucket ARN does not identify objects, so this does NOT confirm object read: it is an action/resource-type mismatch (RESOURCE-ACTION-RESOURCE-MISMATCH, low, policyEvidence low), never a confirmed object-read capability. Remediation distinguishes bucket actions (bucket ARN) from object actions (object ARN). The principal is a same-account role, so a RESOURCE-SAME-ACCOUNT-GRANT also fires for the direct grant - but the object-access claim stays unconfirmed via the mismatch finding.
